description: Pinch, spread or turn with two real fingers (CoreDevice on the iOS Simulator and a physical iPhone): zoom a map or photo, or rotate, in one call. scale above 1 zooms in (fingers spread), below 1 zooms out. The reply says how far a map turned and zoomed, read from the map itself. For other views it says how much of the area changed and shows it. No screenshot is needed. Not on Android or older Xcode, which can't send two fingers.

allowBuoy.description: Pinch even if a finger starts on Buoy.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

rotate.description: Turn the fingers this many degrees while pinching, clockwise. Default 0.

scale.description: How far the fingers spread: 2 doubles the gap (zoom in), 0.5 halves it (zoom out). Default 2.

x.description: Center between the fingers, 0 to 1. Default 0.5.

y.description: Center between the fingers, 0 to 1. Default 0.5.

name: native_pinch
